P11.2: request-release negotiation + soft-conflict check + intent TTL. Pure toron-core/mailbox (ADR-0011 Spec 2/4/6), no MCP tool additions (ADR-0011 Forbidden zone).

SLICE:
(a) 30031 status field: ReservationStatus (Held|Intent|Released|Revoked); status-less = Held (backward compat). active_reservations = held-only (byte-compat); new active_intents() = in-TTL intents.
(b) Soft-conflict check: conflict view splits hard (held, exclusive, other) vs soft (in-TTL intent, other). check_file_reservation_conflicts + file_reservation_paths report soft_conflicts + has_soft_conflicts (ADDITIVE output keys only — C3 frozen names/args untouched). Acquire against intent = freeze (no grant, classified soft, NOT hard block); held hard-blocks unchanged; no conflict grants immediately.
(c) Intent TTL + must-convert: declare_intent() publishes status:intent 30031 + NIP-40 exp (default INTENT_TTL_SECS=300); intent auto-expires by declared+TTL; own acquire at same coordinate supersedes intent -> converts to held.
(d) Request-release negotiation: request_release (typed kind-14 rumor, toron-kind=request-release, reservation-id/e refs, importance high, ack_required) -> respond_request_release (request-release-response + decision tag) -> request_release_status (Pending|Responded|EscalationDue by tier window) -> escalate_request_release (kind-14 DM to captain=operator, toron-kind=request-release-escalation). Force-release untouched (operator last resort).

GATES: acquire-vs-intent = SOFT not hard; held hard-blocks; clear acquire immediate; intent expires after TTL; escalation DM after window.

FILES: crates/toron-core/src/mailbox/reservations.rs (main), toron-mcp tools/mod.rs + responses.rs (additive ToJson/Out fields only).
